vows.name: Woe of Withering
vows.desc: Lay a Woe on every enemy in an area: they take more Poison damage, more damage of every kind and move slower. Tap to cast it once; HOLD to channel it: the area follows your cursor and each enemy under it gathers Dread (+3% Woe effect per Dread, up to 20). An enemy that dies under it spreads the Woe to 2 nearby enemies. Two Woes per enemy. On a Rare, Unique or Guardian it holds until the enemy dies and grows by itself, up to +30%.
notes: On the enemy: takes 10% more damage and 20% more Poison damage; moves 15% slower

vows.name: Toll of Dread
vows.desc: Ring the toll: every Woe in an area is consumed and each cursed enemy takes Poison damage, 10% more per Dread it carried.

vows.desc: Sentence one enemy: it takes 25% more damage from everything. Only one enemy can be Sentenced; sentencing another lifts the first. When it dies you gain an Insight charge. On a Rare, Unique or Guardian the Sentence holds until it dies and grows by itself, up to +30% (32.5% more damage taken).
notes: On the enemy: takes 25% more damage; when it dies you gain Insight

Walk away and it falls. An enemy under both your banner and your Hunter's Marks takes only the stronger of the two.

On a Rare, Unique or Guardian it holds until the enemy dies and grows by itself, up to +30%.

skills.desc: Leap through the air to the target location and crash down, damaging enemies where you land.

skills.desc: Release a ring of frost around you, damaging and chilling every nearby enemy.

skills.name: Chain Lightning
skills.desc: Lightning leaps from your hand to the nearest enemy, then chains between up to {Chains} more, a tenth less on each jump.

skills.name: Toll of Dread
skills.desc: Ring the toll: every Woe in an area is consumed and each cursed enemy takes Poison damage, 10% more per Dread it carried.

skills.name: Storm Whirl
skills.desc: Hold to spin inside a crackling vortex, moving toward the cursor; lightning lashes everything around you and strikes one enemy every turn.

skills.name: Flame Dash
skills.desc: Teleport a short distance toward the cursor in a burst of flame, leaving a burning path that sears enemies standing in it. Every half second the path deals half the damage shown, for 3 seconds.

skills.name: Winter Orb
skills.desc: Conjure every orb of ice you can hold (one to start, more from passives and gear) by your shoulder for 6 seconds. They hurl icicles at nearby enemies (faster with cast speed and Winter Orb fire rate), then shatter in a frost explosion that chills everything around it. At your orb limit, casting again shatters the oldest orb at once.

skills.name: Storm Spark
skills.desc: Throw a crackling spark that latches onto an enemy. Every 0.5 seconds (sooner with cast speed and Spark strike rate) it strikes its host with lightning that leaps to {BrandChains} more {BrandChains}|plural(one=enemy,other=enemies), a tenth less on each jump. When the host dies the spark jumps to another. Lasts {BrandLife} seconds. One cast throws all your Sparks at once (3 to start, more from passives and gear); recast to refresh them. The spark is not a projectile: projectile bonuses do not change it. Tired of recasting it? Socket Cast on Crit in this spark: every critical hit from your attacks casts it for you.

skills.name: Ember Spark
skills.desc: Throw a smouldering spark that latches onto an enemy. Every 0.8 seconds (sooner with cast speed and Spark strike rate) it strikes its host with a heavy blow of fire that sets it burning. It never chains to other enemies: it is the spark for the one enemy that will not die. When the host dies the spark jumps to another. Lasts {BrandLife} seconds. One cast throws all your Sparks at once (3 to start, more from passives and gear); recast to refresh them. The spark is not a projectile: projectile bonuses do not change it. Tired of recasting it? Socket Cast on Crit in this spark: every critical hit from your attacks casts it for you.

skills.name: Rime Spark
skills.desc: Throw a freezing spark that latches onto an enemy. Every 0.7 seconds (sooner with cast speed and Spark strike rate) it strikes its host with frost that leaps to {BrandChains} more {BrandChains}|plural(one=enemy,other=enemies), a tenth less on each jump, chilling the whole pack. When the host dies the spark jumps to another. Lasts {BrandLife} seconds. One cast throws all your Sparks at once (3 to start, more from passives and gear); recast to refresh them. The spark is not a projectile: projectile bonuses do not change it. Tired of recasting it? Socket Cast on Crit in this spark: every critical hit from your attacks casts it for you.

skills.name: Venom Spark
skills.desc: Throw a festering spark that latches onto an enemy. Every 0.4 seconds (sooner with cast speed and Spark strike rate) it strikes its host and {BrandChains} more {BrandChains}|plural(one=enemy,other=enemies) with venom, a tenth less on each jump, and every strike adds a poison: the longer it crawls, the deeper they rot. When the host dies the spark jumps to another. Lasts {BrandLife} seconds. One cast throws all your Sparks at once (3 to start, more from passives and gear); recast to refresh them. The spark is not a projectile: projectile bonuses do not change it. Tired of recasting it? Socket Cast on Crit in this spark: every critical hit from your attacks casts it for you.

skills.name: Thunderfall
skills.desc: Strike three times with your staff or wand. The third blow calls lightning down on every enemy in front of you. Its damage is lightning. Spell damage modifiers also apply to it.
notes: Counts as Spell too, so spell bonuses and supports apply

skills.name: Glacial Shards
skills.desc: Flick {Projectiles} shards of ice from your wand or staff. Each bursts into frost on the first enemy it strikes, chilling everything nearby. Its damage is cold. Spell damage modifiers also apply to it.
notes: Extra projectile at gem level 10 and 18
Counts as Spell too, so spell bonuses and supports apply

skills.name: Reap
skills.desc: Your scythe's basic attack, no mana cost. A wide, hungry sweep that cuts everything in front of you.
notes: Weapon basic attack: not a gem, it levels with your hero (plus gear levels)

skills.name: Death Coil
skills.desc: Your scythe's mana skill. Hurl a coil of grave-magic that seeks the nearest foe ahead and bursts on it, rotting everything nearby.
notes: Weapon skill: not a gem, it levels with your hero (plus gear levels)

skills.name: Summon Skeletons
skills.desc: Raise skeleton warriors from the ground: two, and one more at gem levels 6, 11 and 16 (every 5 gem levels). While you are below level 10 it raises 2 more and costs half the mana, a starter's help that ends at level 10. They follow you and fight until they fall.
notes: Minion skill: this is the base the minions start from, their own damage multiplier applies on top

skills.name: Summon Skeletal Mage
skills.desc: Raise skeletal mages that keep their distance and hurl bolts of dark magic at your foes: one, two from gem level 9, three from gem level 17. They stay until they fall.
notes: Minion skill: this is the base the minions start from, their own damage multiplier applies on top

skills.name: Drain Life
skills.desc: Hold to tether the enemy under the cursor with a beam of grave-hunger: it rots while you drink, and the beam forks on to 3 more enemies nearby, each link a tenth weaker. A fifth of the damage comes back to you as life, and your minions drink with you.

skills.name: Vampire Dash
skills.desc: Come apart into mist and bats and gather again a short way toward the cursor. The mist lingers on your path and rots whatever stands in it.

skills.name: Grave Golem
skills.desc: Tear a golem of grave-fire out of the earth. It is enormous, soaks up blows meant for you and smashes the ground around it; it burns in the colour of its supports' element. Only one answers at a time. Each golem blesses those near it: the grave golem heals you 1% of your life a second, the flame golem gives your minions 12.5% more damage, the ice golem gives you 31% more armour, the storm golem makes your minions 15% faster, and the venom golem makes enemies take 7.5% more damage. The golem grows with your level: the deeper the Ruptures, the harder it hits.
notes: Minion skill: this is the base the minions start from, their own damage multiplier applies on top

skills.name: Raise Zombie
skills.desc: Drag a zombie up out of the ground: two stand at once, three from gem level 16, four from gem level 24. Zombies stay until they fall, grow with the gem, hit hard and every fourth blow slams the ground round their foe. Supports such as Brutality or Flame make them brutal or burning.
notes: Minion skill: this is the base the minions start from, their own damage multiplier applies on top

skills.name: Unholy Void
skills.desc: Open a void of unholy energy around you: enemies inside take poison damage twice a second, 70% of the damage shown each time. The void gnaws at you too: 0.9% of your life per second, less with poison resistance, never the last tenth of your life. Press again to close it.

skills.name: Gravereap
skills.desc: Sweep your weapon in a wide arc. Enemies it kills rise as Risen Thralls that fight for you until they fall: up to 3, and one more at gem levels 7, 13 and 19; a new one replaces the oldest. 40% of its damage is poison. On a Guardian or Unique enemy, where nothing dies, every 4% of its life your hits take raises one too.
notes: Kills rise as thralls that fight for you (up to 3, more at gem levels 7, 13, 19); the damage shown is the swing itself

skills.name: Marrow Lance
skills.desc: Hurl a lance of bone that pierces through the line. Enemies it kills rise as Risen Casters that fight for you until they fall: up to 3, and one more at gem levels 7, 13 and 19; a new one replaces the oldest. 40% of its damage is poison. On a Guardian or Unique enemy, where nothing dies, every 4% of its life your hits take raises one too.
notes: Kills rise as thralls that fight for you (up to 3, more at gem levels 7, 13, 19); the damage shown is the swing itself

skills.name: Pyre Burst
skills.desc: Set a fresh corpse near your aim ablaze. It bursts in fire, hitting every enemy around it, and deals 10% of the slain's maximum life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life) as extra fire (20% at gem level 20). Your own fallen minions count as corpses. With no corpse there, your nearest minion is sacrificed instead.

skills.name: Hammer Blow
skills.desc: Your mace's basic attack, no mana cost. A heavy blow at the enemy in front of you.
notes: Weapon basic attack: not a gem, it levels with your hero (plus gear levels)

skills.name: Holy Slash
skills.desc: A wide sweep that leaves a crescent of holy light, striking every enemy in front of you. Your mace's mana skill; Hammer Blow is its free attack.
notes: Weapon skill: not a gem, it levels with your hero (plus gear levels)

skills.name: Judgement
skills.desc: Raise your weapon to the sky: a moment later bolts of holy light crash down on the target and the enemies nearest it, one after another, each exploding on impact. {Projectiles} {Projectiles}|plural(one=bolt,other=bolts); one more at gem levels 10 and 20. The bolts are not projectiles: Projectile skill bonuses do not change them. Judgement is a Skyfall skill: every Skyfall line reaches it, and second fall lines (Twice Judged, Twice-Fallen Sky) drop the sky again where each bolt lands (each enemy takes one second fall per cast).
notes: Extra projectile at gem level 10 and 20

skills.name: Orbiting Hammers
skills.desc: Turn on a ring of {OrbitCount} spectral hammers that sweeps out through the enemies around you and back again, smashing everything it passes. It drains 6 mana a second while it spins (more with supports); press again to turn it off, and it stops when your mana runs out. One more hammer at gem levels 4, 8, 12, 16 and 20; from five hammers a second, outer ring turns the other way and pulses out as the inner one comes in. Hammerstorm empowers it.

skills.name: Consecrated Ground
skills.desc: Plant your weapon and hallow the ground around you for 5 seconds. Enemies on it burn with holy light, are slowed, take 20% more damage from every hit and are struck critically more often (+8% chance); you regenerate 2% of your life per second while you stand on it.

skills.name: Holy Charge
skills.desc: Charge behind your shield toward the cursor and bash the first enemy in your path, stunning it. Where the charge ends, holy light burns the ground for 2 seconds, slowing enemies and healing you. The bash deals the full damage shown; the holy light deals 35% of it every half second. Movement skill: cancels the end of an attack.

skills.name: Holy Elemental
skills.desc: Call down a Holy Elemental of living light. It fights at your side, smashing your foes with blows of holy light that strike everything around them, until it is destroyed. A second elemental answers at gem level 10. Its light shelters you: within 9 metres of it you have +6% chance to block and regenerate 0.5% of your life a second. Shared Light: past 4 elementals, each deals 4% less per extra elemental standing (12: 32% less each). The army never shrinks, only the blow each one lands.
notes: Minion skill: this is the base the minions start from, their own damage multiplier applies on top

skills.name: Pyre of Faith
skills.desc: Light a pyre of holy fire around you: enemies inside burn twice a second for fire damage that grows with your maximum life. The pyre burns you too: 6% of your life per second, a quarter of that at 75% fire resistance, never the last tenth of your life: you need life regeneration. Press again to put it out. Its burn is a Fire spell hit: Fire, Spell, Area and Holy damage scale it; Burning damage modifiers scale Ignites, not the pyre.

skills.name: Hallowed Slam
skills.desc: Bring your weapon down on the ground in front of you. Where it lands the ground is hallowed for 3 seconds: enemies on it burn and take more damage from every hit, and you regain life while you stand in it.

skills.name: Shield Throw
skills.desc: Hurl your shield at the enemy in front of you. It rings off the first enemy it strikes into the next, up to 3 more times, a little weaker at every leap. A Shield skill: while you hold a shield it gains 1% increased damage per 5 armour, evasion and energy shield on that shield, and Shield skill bonuses apply. Without a shield it keeps its full base damage.

skills.name: Quick Shot
skills.desc: Loose an arrow at the target. Free to use.
notes: Weapon basic attack: not a gem, it levels with your hero (plus gear levels)

skills.name: Piercing Shot
skills.desc: Draw the bow to its full and loose a heavy arrow that pierces every enemy in its path.
notes: Weapon skill: not a gem, it levels with your hero (plus gear levels)

skills.name: Split Shot
skills.desc: Loose a fan of {Projectiles} arrows. Each enemy is struck by one arrow. One more arrow at gem levels 8 and 16.
notes: Extra projectile at gem level 8 and 16

skills.name: Rain of Arrows
skills.desc: Fire a volley into the sky. A moment later it rains down on the target area, striking every enemy inside three times. Aimed at an enemy, the volley leads it: it falls where that enemy will be when the arrows land.

skills.name: Wind Vault
skills.desc: Vault toward the cursor on a gust of wind (or back, away from it, when the cursor is close), shoving nearby enemies away on landing and loosing three arrows at the nearest. The damage shown is a full hit: each landing arrow deals 60% of it and the gust 15%. Cancels attacks. The arrows are not projectiles: Projectile skill bonuses do not change them.

skills.name: Lightning Arrow
skills.desc: Loose an arrow charged with lightning. Half its physical damage is converted to lightning. When it strikes an enemy, lightning leaps from it to {Chains} more {Chains}|plural(one=enemy,other=enemies) for 72% of the hit, a tenth less on each jump. The first enemy takes the full damage shown. With no other enemy in reach, the leaps it cannot make come back into that enemy as one extra strike, so a lone boss takes about 29% more.

skills.name: Ballista
skills.desc: Plant a ballista where you aim (up to 9 metres away) that turns on the nearest enemy and looses heavy bolts for 10 seconds. One at a time: the Multiple Totems support and the passive tree add more, and every one you add counts. Supports on this gem change its bolts. Each bolt pierces one enemy; with Chain or Fork linked it chains or forks at its first enemy instead.

skills.name: Caustic Arrow
skills.desc: Loose a rotten arrow that bursts into a caustic cloud where it strikes. The cloud lingers for 3 seconds and poisons every enemy inside. 60% of its damage is poison.

skills.name: Fuse Arrow
skills.desc: Loose an arrow with a burning fuse. It bursts in fire where it strikes, hitting every enemy around the target. 60% of its damage is fire.

skills.name: Twin Cuts
skills.desc: Your blades' basic attack, no mana cost. A quick cut with each blade at the enemy in front of you.
notes: Weapon basic attack: not a gem, it levels with your hero (plus gear levels)

skills.name: Flurry
skills.desc: A storm of five quick cuts in front of you; the last one is a heavy finisher that throws enemies back. Your blades' mana skill; Twin Cuts is their free attack.
notes: Weapon skill: not a gem, it levels with your hero (plus gear levels)

skills.name: Iaido Thrust
skills.desc: Dash through enemies toward the cursor, cutting everything on your line. A moment later you sheathe and they bleed for a second cut. The dash cut deals the full damage shown, the sheathe cut 38% of it. Every enemy you cut stays marked for 5 seconds, and each new cut on a marked enemy adds 25% of that cut to its mark: Sheathe makes them burst. Movement skill: cancels the end of an attack.

skills.name: Crescent Slash
skills.desc: A heavy cross cut with both blades. The cut flies on as a crescent wave that slices through every enemy on its line.

skills.name: Shuriken Fan
skills.desc: Flick a fan of {Projectiles} spinning shuriken at the enemy. Each one cuts through {Pierce} {Pierce}|plural(one=foe,other=foes) before it stops. One more at gem levels 10 and 18.
notes: Extra projectile at gem level 10 and 18

skills.name: Blade Vortex
skills.desc: {OrbitCount} spectral {OrbitCount}|plural(one=blade joins,other=blades join) a ring that circles you for 6 seconds, sweeping out into the pack and back, cutting every enemy they pass. Cast again to add more: up to {OrbitMax} blades. While it is on your bar, every basic attack that lands adds a blade.

skills.name: Thousand Cuts
skills.desc: Become a blur of steel: fly from group to group around you five times, cutting everything near each one. The last cut is the heaviest. You end beside the last group you cut. Counts as a Movement skill and as a dash: movement supports, passives, items and Echo Cut apply (Echo Cut adds one more cut where you end). It is still a melee attack.

skills.name: Sheathe
skills.desc: Sheathe your blades with a click. Every enemy your Iaido Thrust has marked bursts apart, nearest first, for 160% of its mark, and half of that to everything around it. A mark is the strongest Iaido cut on that enemy plus 25% of every other cut it took while marked, so thrust through it a few times before you sheathe. Needs marks: cut enemies with Iaido Thrust first.

skills.name: Viper Fang
skills.desc: Three quick poisoned stabs at the enemy in front of you. Most of their damage is poison, and every stab lays a stack of poison that keeps eating at the enemy after you move on.

skills.name: Moonfall
skills.desc: Leap to the cursor and fall on the enemies there with both blades. As you sheathe them a moment later, every enemy you struck is cut again for half the damage. Movement skill: cancels the end of an attack.

skills.name: Cyclone
skills.desc: Hold to spin with your weapon outstretched, moving toward the cursor through enemies and cutting everything around you. Costs mana while you spin.

skills.name: Shield Charge
skills.desc: Charge toward the cursor behind your shield, ploughing through every enemy in your way, and burst on arrival: the blast hits everything around you. Each enemy the blast catches gives back 1.5 mana. Almost no cooldown, chain it from pack to pack.

skills.name: Earthshatter
skills.desc: Slam the ground so hard it splits: a fissure tears toward the cursor, hitting everything on its line. Enemies it kills leave a spike of rock that shatters a moment later, hitting those around it.

skills.name: Rending Slam
skills.desc: Bring a two-handed weapon down so hard the ground rends: a shock runs out in a straight line toward the cursor, hitting every enemy on it. Your body is in the blow: 4% of your maximum life joins the weapon's base damage. No cooldown.

skills.name: Wheeling Axe
skills.desc: Hurl a spinning axe toward the cursor. It cuts through every enemy in its path, then wheels back to your hand and cuts them again on the way.
